map.生活事件应激量表(基于Holmes-Rahe社会再适应评定量表SRRS)，勾选过: Life Events Stress Scale (based on the Holmes-Rahe Social Readjustment Rating Scale, SRRS): check life events experienced in the past 12 months; it accumulates Life Change Units (LCU) and assesses stress-related health risk.
map.生活事件应激总分 = Σ各事件赋值；小于150低风险（重疾风险约30%）、150: Life-event stress total = sum of event weights; <150 low risk (serious-illness risk ~30%), 150-299 medium (~50%), >=300 high (~80%).
map.本量表为应激压力自助评估参考，\"健康风险\"为群体统计关联而非个体预测。高应激: This is a self-help stress reference; 'health risk' reflects group statistics, not individual prediction. Under high stress, strengthen self-care, social support and professional help when needed.
map.勾选近一年事件并按权重求和：丧偶 100、失业 47、家庭矛盾 35、健康恶化: Check past-year events and sum weights: spouse loss 100, job loss 47, family conflict 35, health decline 38 -> about 220, high life-event load; mind psychosomatic health.
map.仅婚恋 50 + 小变动 10 → 60，压力负荷较低。: Only marriage/love 50 + minor change 10 -> 60, lower stress load.
map.各事件有固定应激权重（正/负），勾选项相加得总分，越高近期生活变动越大。: Each event has a fixed stress weight (positive/negative); checked items sum to the total; higher means more recent life change.
map.用于心身医学与应激研究，提示近期生活变动与发病/复发风险关联，不替代诊断。: Used in psychosomatic medicine and stress research to flag links between recent life change and onset/relapse risk; not a diagnosis.

map.生活事件(LES)应激值评估器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Life Events Scale (LES) Stress Assessment. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
